Subject: Opportunity: 2yr prepay + phased ramp - initial ask

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Catalyst is excited about Redwood's latency profile for our inference-heavy recommender. We're looking at a 2-year commitment and want to understand whether there's room for a blended term discount and a billing split (annual vs quarterly) to match our cash flow. High level ask:

- Commitment: $1.2M USD total over 24 months (we'll provide monthly usage forecast)
- Desired commercial: 2-year prepay with a staged ramp (50% of prepay in year 1, 50% in year 2)
- Requested term discount: target ~28% blended off list, with escalation clause if usage exceeds forecast
- SLA / credits: want a small SLA credit if latencies exceed target more than 3x in any month

I've attached our usage forecast and happy to hop on a quick call. Our procurement lead (cc'd on future threads) will need an outline of the billing and any cancellation/true-up mechanics.

Attachments: Catalyst_Usage_Forecast.xlsx (forecast by month, v1)

Cheers,
Sam Brooks
Head of Platform Partnerships

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Catalyst 2yr prepay + phased ramp - approval request

Team — forwarding Catalyst's ask. Key commercial points summarized below; they want a blended ~28% off list for a $1.2M 2-year prepay with staged billing (50/50), plus a small SLA credit candidate.

My proposed (initial) structure to present to the customer:
- Term: 24 months, prepay $1.2M total
- Billing: Invoice 50% upfront (due on signing), 50% invoiced at 12 months (prepaid)
- Pricing: 27% blended discount off our hosted list rates (equivalent to $876k net) — this preserves margin vs a straight 30%
- Ramp breakpoints (to protect us): if monthly usage exceeds forecast by 25% for two consecutive months, pricing tiers escalate and we propose a top-up true-up invoice at M12
- SLA: 99.9% regional availability SLO; if monthly p99 latency > 3x target, provide a 3% credit applied to next invoice (we should limit credits to a max of 5% of total contract per year)

Attachments: RW_Pricing_Model_v3.xlsx — shows blended math + margin sensitivity.

I need approval to offer 27% (with the limits above) and to use the billing split. Finance will need the DocuSign flow and a revenue recognition note.

Thanks,
Kimberly
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Catalyst 2yr prepay + phased ramp - approval request

Kimberly — reviewed the pricing model. I'm comfortable approving a discount in the 25–27% range with these commercial guardrails: 

- Approve up to 25% outright with standard T&Cs.
- For 26–27% we need BOTH: (a) auto-renew clause for a subsequent 12-month term at the end of year 2 unless Catalyst gives 90 days notice, AND (b) a capped credit exposure: SLA credits capped at 5% of annual invoice and true-up invoices payable on net 30.
- Require Finance sign-off on the revenue recognition treatment for 50/50 prepay; if they want recognized upfront we may need ARR adjustments.

If Catalyst is flexible on the auto-renew and the capped credit, prioritize 27% to move the deal. If not, we can offer 25% and be firm. Marcus, please confirm runway on capacity for this customer — we need to ensure their peak months are covered.

—Karthik
From: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sam Brooks <sam.brooks@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: 2-year prepay (Catalyst) — adjusted offer and next steps

Sam — thanks for the quick patience while we coordinated internally. Below is our formal offer based on the forecast you shared and the guardrails we discussed: 

Offer summary (two-year prepay):
- Total commitment: $1,200,000 USD prepay over 24 months
- Billing: 50% invoiced on signing (due on receipt), 50% invoiced at month 12 (prepaid)
- Commercial: 27% blended discount off list rates (net $876,000) — contingent on the auto-renew clause below
- Auto-renew: Contract will auto-renew for a 12-month period at the end of year 2 unless either party provides notice 90 days before term end
- Ramp protection: If actual monthly usage exceeds forecast by >25% for two consecutive months we will issue a mid-term true-up at month 12 for overage at list rates (no retroactive discounts)
- SLA credits: 3% credit per affected month if monthly p99 latency > 3x target; capped at 5% of annual invoice amount

Attachments: Catalyst_SOW_v1.2.pdf, RW_Pricing_Model_v3.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Confirm procurement contact and whether the 50/50 invoice cadence works for your AP team.
2) If acceptable, we'll send a DocuSign package (SOW + Master Services Agreement + pricing schedule) for signature.
3) On receipt of the initial invoice payment we will schedule onboarding and reserve capacity.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Sign/XYZ123456 (will be live once procurement confirms)

If procurement needs a different billing split (annual upfront vs 50/50), tell me and we'll re-run the model.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
